# WebKit v20 pinned-source license-text candidates

This directory preserves exact license, notice, copying, and patent-text filename candidates from WebKit commit `43d5b8d85e2e5eed41d7ff8a79da831bf405be6c`, associated with the NeAntik v20 patch SHA-256 `b33b9320bd8f3bae56eadebc738fe91d40f0cf77e89fd2885bf28679d2af0735`.

`MANIFEST.json` binds every copied path, byte count, and SHA-256 to the pinned source inventory. The corpus contains 308 files (1,743,244 bytes). It is factual source material for the release/source offer, not a legal applicability decision: some candidates may belong to tests or source components not shipped by NeAntik. Final notices must map applicable terms to the exact production images/resources.
